design.identity: Every model-selected story has a deterministic public bundle identity from the original logical run and its unique model story_id. Research source identities remain separate, many-to-many references.
design.source_preservation: Original research bundles are retained unchanged except their display flag. Every selected source and source bundle remains attached to the public story drilldown.
design.ticker_metadata: Model-selected supporting symbols determine the public ticker. Market observations are read by that ticker; a broader research source cannot silently supply another company ticker or return.
design.scope: Existing publication owner only. No prompt/model/provider/schedule/budget/retrieval changes; no additional research flow or model call.

retained_cases.basis: Actual paid model selection/body and original source index; metadata reconstructed from same-run retained observations, articles, claims and event research.
Full previously accepted stored publication and bundles, with its original reader source index.

reviewed_consumers.preservation: Only Home publication function changes. Worker command bindings, all other producers, shared engine/accounting/deadlines and configuration remain the already accepted coherent source. API/broker use their prior exact qualified images; frontend/native clients consume the unchanged DTO.

release.production_authorization_basis: Standing owner instruction to fix the release and push once verified, plus explicit approval of the coherent candidate. This corrects its first scheduled publication failure; no expanded feature or paid run.

freshness: No retained historical comparison is republished as current. No manual paid production run started.

source_integration.preservation: Current Trading release is the Git base. Its API, broker, web, native and paper-account behavior is retained. Only the one publisher correction is applied; all other application files remain byte-identical to the accepted Trading source. Both retained-output replays and all11 operational checks pass again on this integrated source.
source_integration.initial_preflight: The earlier315-file candidate was rejected before any build because its retained-image proof did not cover the newly deployed Trading images. No Azure image mutation or ACR build occurred from that candidate.
